deviations: Anderson (2008) indices: items standardized by control-group (born Jan 1956 or later, full +/-72-month respondent sample) mean/SD, combined with inverse-covariance weights (row sums of inverse covariance of standardized items, computed on respondents answering all 20 SRQ-20 items), then the index is rescaled to control-group mean 0 / SD 1. Indices and SRQ-20 sum defined only for respondents answering all 20 items. The paper's main text describes a simple average of z-scores while Appendix B describes inverse-covariance weighting; Appendix B was followed.
Bandwidth +/-45 implemented as |dif| <= 45, where dif = months older than December 1955 (treated: dif >= 0).

Estimated with fixest::feols (month, province, surveyor FE absorbed; education and ethnicity category dummies and female as regressors; clustered by month-year of birth). fixest drops fixed-effect singletons (15-16 obs here), as reghdfe would; the reported N excludes them.
notes: Two exploratory runs (attempt-1: variable listing; attempt-2: running-variable coding, control categories, missingness), no RESULT lines. Final run: RD with treatment z = born in/before Dec 1955, linear running variable with slope allowed to differ across the cutoff, uniform kernel, 45-month bandwidth, respondents only (non_response == 0), listwise deletion on outcome and controls. No runs hung; each sandbox run took ~1 s.
